name: Anjali Nair
headline: Data Analyst · SQL, Power BI, Python
summary: Data analyst with 3 years in retail and fintech. I turn messy sales and payments data into weekly Power BI reports that managers actually use, and I automate the boring parts with SQL and Python.

bullets: Built a Power BI sales dashboard for 42 stores that replaced 6 manual Excel reports; regional managers now check it every Monday.
Wrote SQL checks that catch duplicate bills before month-end, cutting reconciliation time from 3 days to 1.
Found that 18% of returns came from two product lines with wrong size charts; fixing the charts brought returns down by a third in one quarter.
Trained 9 store supervisors to read the dashboard and raise stock requests from it.
Cleaned and joined UPI transaction logs (about 2 lakh rows a day) in Python for the fraud team's daily report.
Automated a weekly merchant summary with Python and Google Sheets, saving the team about 5 hours a week.
Answered ad-hoc data questions from product and ops teams, usually within the same day.

projects.name: KSRTC bus delay analysis
bullets: Scraped 6 months of public arrival data and showed which routes run late most often, with a simple map in Python.

certifications.name: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate
